# htmx v4.0.1 Multi-Portal Documentation & Diagnostic Suite (Unofficial Drawlib & PNI501 Showcase)

> Unofficial community documentation, API catalog, internal architecture walkthrough, and PNI501 software audit of htmx v4.0.1 (`https://htmx.drawlib.com/`).
> Official htmx documentation: https://htmx.org/ and https://four.htmx.org/

## Portals

- [htmx v4 User Guide (EN/JA)](https://htmx.drawlib.com/user_guide/): Practical developer guide covering Hypermedia-Driven Application (HDA) design, explicit `:inherited` attribute inheritance, built-in Idiomorph DOM morphing (`innerMorph`, `outerMorph`), `<hx-partial>` multi-region updates, declarative `hx-status:*` routing, official streaming/reactive extensions (`hx-sse`, `hx-ws`, `hx-live`), and strict CSP security (`https://htmx.drawlib.com/user_guide/llms.txt`).
- [htmx v4 API Reference Catalog (EN/JA)](https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/): Searchable symbol & attribute reference catalog covering every `hx-*` attribute, modifier, HCON syntax, `HX-*` HTTP header, `htmx.*` JS API method, `htmx.config` option, `HtmxEventMap` DOM event, all 17 official extensions, and the `upgrade-check` CLI (`https://htmx.drawlib.com/api/llms.txt`).
- [htmx v4 Internal Architecture Guide (EN/JA)](https://htmx.drawlib.com/architecture/): Source-level guide to `src/htmx.js` and `src/ext/*.js` internals: single-class `Htmx` engine, `HCON` parser, trigger lexer & `RequestQueue` state machine, `fetch()` pipeline, built-in Idiomorph reconciliation, and `#internalAPI` extension hooks (`https://htmx.drawlib.com/architecture/llms.txt`).
- [PNI501 Diagnostic Report (HTML & PDF)](https://htmx.drawlib.com/pni501/): Deterministic 15-stage JavaScript AST, module dependency DAG, hermetic Playwright Chromium browser test runtime, V8 coverage, and supply-chain security audit (`https://htmx.drawlib.com/pni501/pni501.pdf`, `https://htmx.drawlib.com/pni501/llms.txt`).
